## What he does
- Works directly with dealers and their software vendors on how leads reach sales teams, how customers book appointments, and how staff handle service requests.
- Built Network OS, which replaced manual lead forwarding with ZIP-based territory routing for a network of about 86 Window Depot USA dealer locations.
- Built native CRM integrations for Builder Prime and MarketSharp. Deployed AI webchat for dealers; in Dallas the chat booked an in-home estimate on the dealer's calendar and the dealer later confirmed the sale (the sale belongs to the dealer).
- Connected Gravity Forms, n8n, and Asana into a service queue staff used to close 615 requests; AI classification gave 216 tasks descriptive titles.
- Gave marketing staff read-only Google Ads querying in ChatGPT; verified reporting across 16 client accounts.
- Built and operates XPRT Cloud (https://goxprt.com), which turns drone imagery from Part 107 flights into shareable jobsite reports and 3D views. Owns the Next.js interface, Python API, Stripe billing, and Docker deployment.
